headline: Circuit Breaker Labs hopes to make AI safer for your kids (and you)
context: With all the talk about how AI might one day kill us all, it's easy to forget that AI has already harmed some people psychologically. Circuit Breaker Labs has created "crash-test dummies" to solve that.
